LOVING VETERINARY CARE FOR YOUR EXOTIC PETS
Dr Karli Du Preez of Exotic Vet Century City, Cape Town, is an exotic veterinary surgeon who is passionate to provide loving care and treatment for Exotic Pets.

Our primary patients are birds which includes parrots, parakeets, lorikeets, ducks, pigeons and chickens, rabbits, rats, mice, snakes & hamsters, reptiles, guinea pigs, primates, and wildlife.

It's important to choose an exotic veterinary hospital and surgery with experienced staff and veterinarians who are knowledgeable about the specific needs of your exotic pet.

Exotic animal patients are small and delicate and therefore require refined micro-surgical technique. Exotic Vet Century City Hospital have specialized equipment and facilities tailored to the care of exotic animals, as well as staff who are trained and experienced to handle their unique behaviors and health concerns.
